messages.subject: PyStan 2.10.0.0 available on PyPI
parts:
PyStan 2.11.0.0 is now available on PyPI:

https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pystan

Source installation via pip is working on all platforms. Windows wheels
are ready. Linux and OS X wheels will be along shortly.

============
What's New
============

V2.11.0.0 (28. July 2016)
=========================
- Update Stan source to v2.11.0 (`release notes
<https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/releases/tag/v2.11.0>`_)
